title: How long you'd last if your plane lost pressure ✈️
subject: airplane
description:
Would you get your mask on in time? 👇

What happens to your body if a plane loses cabin pressure at 35,000 feet? Aviation medicine tables give you 30 seconds to 1 minute of useful consciousness, and low oxygen can feel calm, even pleasant. In FAA altitude chamber tests, people couldn't write their names but thought they were fine.

Sources: FAA ("Hypoxia: The Higher You Fly… The Less Air in the Sky"), Naval Medical Research Unit Dayton (NAMRU-D Report 16-19, time of useful consciousness table), Wikipedia ("Helios Airways Flight 522", citing the Greek AAIASB final report)

scenes.text: Your plane loses pressure at 35,000 feet. You get about 30 seconds.
Pilots call it time of useful consciousness: 30 seconds to 1 minute up there.
You probably won't panic. Low oxygen can feel calm, even pleasant.
In FAA chamber tests, people couldn't write their names, yet thought they were fine.
In 2005, the pilots of Helios Airways Flight 522 mistook their pressure alarm for another warning and blacked out.
That's why the masks drop on their own, and why yours goes on first.
